reviewed.name: Briza minor
reviewed.visible: Small nearly triangular pendulous spikelets on fine pedicels and low annual grassy plant, compatible with little quaking grass.
reviewed.not_determined: No scaled multi-floret dissection or ligule measurements; only one Hays record.
reviewed.next: Measure 3–8 florets, ligule length and mature triangular spikelets.

reviewed.name: Cenchrus ciliaris
reviewed.visible: Dense cylindrical buffelgrass-like head with long bristles, collar and habitat views.
reviewed.not_determined: Fused bristle bases forming detachable bur, and comparison to Setaria are not conclusive.
reviewed.next: Show one bur removed intact with united bristle bases and mm scale.

reviewed.name: Janochloa antidotalis
reviewed.visible: Excellent close panicles, mature spikelets, culm nodes, leaves and collar on one specimen.
reviewed.not_determined: Exact glume/lemma measurements and spontaneous establishment versus forage planting still need review.
reviewed.next: Close mature glumes and lemma/palea with ruler; compare to Panicum hallii and older Panicum antidotale account.

reviewed.name: Miscanthus sinensis
reviewed.visible: Clumped tall arching narrow leaves in an ornamental-looking garden setting.
reviewed.not_determined: No panicle or spikelets; cannot verify species or wild occurrence.
reviewed.next: Mature flowering plume and hairy spikelets, ligule, evidence of escaped stand.

reviewed.name: Panicum repens
reviewed.visible: Dense green grassy mat with some thin flowering branches visible only at distance.
reviewed.not_determined: Rhizome/stolon structures and diagnostic spikelets absent; one image cannot resolve torpedograss.
reviewed.next: Excavate creeping rhizomes, provide ligule and scaled flowering spikelets.

reviewed.name: Pappophorum bicolor
reviewed.visible: Dry grassland tuft with long hairy feathered flowering heads and good separate head details.
reviewed.not_determined: Individual lemma appendage number and attachment details not counted.
reviewed.next: Dissect mature floret and measure lemma awn appendages on mm scale.

reviewed.name: Sclerochloa dura
reviewed.visible: Small low grass with short dense one-sided green inflorescence spikes in disturbed ground.
reviewed.not_determined: No scale for multi-flowered spikelets, ligule or glume/lemma nerve count.
reviewed.next: Show 3–4 florets, blunt nerved glumes/lemmas and 1–2 mm ligule.

reviewed.name: Stapfochloa canterae
reviewed.visible: Very useful image set: ciliate racemes, culm node/ligule, detached spikelets and metric ruler in frame.
reviewed.not_determined: Precise fertile/sterile floret/awn comparison against Stapfochloa ciliata needs formal measurement.
reviewed.next: Compare scale-matched spikelets to Stapfochloa ciliata and related Chloris.
